scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Welcome to the world of Arena, the battle against a time limit.
My name is Vendigos, I am here to help you.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
欢迎来到竞技场，在这里与时间赛跑吧。
我是文迪戈斯，很乐意为你提供帮助。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
有什么问题，随时问我就好。

scripts.text: How to challenge
scripts.translation: 挑战方法

scripts.text: About Arena Points
scripts.translation: 关于竞技场点数

scripts.text: My Current Arena Points
scripts.translation: 查询当前竞技场点数

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
There are two different kinds of arena mode such as ^3131FFPlayer Mode^000000 and ^3131FFParty Mode^000000.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
竞技场有两种不同的模式，分别是^3131FF单人模式^000000和^3131FF队伍模式^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
^3131FFPlayer Mode^000000 consists of 4 different stages based on character level from 50~80.
For a party with 5 members, they can participate in ^3131FFParty Mode^000000.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
^3131FF单人模式^000000按角色等级分为50～80级的4个关卡。
5人队伍则可以参加^3131FF队伍模式^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
For ^3131FFeach Player Mode Stage^000000, characters who are 20 levels higher than the level requirement on each stage cannot enter. This is to prevent high level characters preoccupying a low level stage.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
在^3131FF单人模式的各个关卡^000000中，比该关卡要求的等级高出20级或以上的角色无法进入，以免高等级角色占用低等级关卡。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
There are the NPCs for Player Mode Stages from 12 o'clock direction to the reversed clock direction.
While you're waiting in a chat room, you will be automatically guided to an arena room by the waiting order.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
单人模式各关卡的NPC从12点钟方向开始，按逆时针排列。
进入聊天室等待后，会按排队顺序自动将你传送到竞技场。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Let me explain about the ^3131FFArena Point^000000.
It is a reward point for players who ^3131FFsuccessfully cleared a arena stage^000000, a player can possess the maximum 30,000 points.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
让我介绍一下^3131FF竞技场点数^000000。
这是给^3131FF成功通关竞技场关卡^000000的玩家的奖励，每位玩家最多可持有30,000点。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Even if you did not clear a stage due to time-over or other errors, you will be given a very small amount of arena points.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
即使因超时或其他问题没能通关，你也能获得少量竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Regarding the use of Arena Points,
we are providing various services such as souvenir photograph services through an NPC named Givu.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
竞技场点数可以用于各种服务，比如找吉武拍摄纪念照。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Let me check {0}'s current arena points.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
让我查看一下{0}当前的竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
{0} has total ^3131FF{1}^000000 points.

[Vendigos]
If you wish to know how to use arena points, please refer to the 2nd menu ^3131FF'About Arena Points'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
想了解如何使用竞技场点数，请选择第二个选项^3131FF“关于竞技场点数”^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Okay then,
please have
a good time.
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
那么，祝你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Vendigos]
Is there anything
more I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[文迪戈斯]
还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Owen Kheuv]
Hello, my name is Own Kheuv
in charge of every arena stage record of players.
scripts.translation:
[欧文·克夫]
你好，我是欧文·克夫，负责管理竞技场各关卡的玩家纪录。

scripts.text:
[Owen Kheuv]
Would you like to check the top record players in each stage?
If so, please choose a menu below.
scripts.translation:
[欧文·克夫]
想查看各关卡的纪录保持者吗？
请选择下方的选项。

scripts.text: Lv 50 Stage
scripts.translation: 50级关卡

scripts.text: Lv 60 Stage
scripts.translation: 60级关卡

scripts.text: Lv 70 Stage
scripts.translation: 70级关卡

scripts.text: Lv 80 Stage
scripts.translation: 80级关卡

scripts.text: Party Stage
scripts.translation: 队伍关卡

scripts.text:
[Owen Kheuv]
Currently the top player of the arena Lv 50 stage is ^3131FF {0}^000000, the top record is ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds.

[Owen Kheuv]
Currenly the top player of the arena Lv 60 stage is ^3131FF{0}^000000, the top record is ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds.

[Owen Kheuv]
Currenly the top player of the arena Lv 70 stage is ^3131FF{0}^000000, the top record is ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds.

[Owen Kheuv]
Currenly the top player of the arena Lv 80 stage is ^3131FF{0}^000000, the top record is ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds.

[Owen Kheuv]
Currenly the top party is ^3131FF{0}^000000, the top record is ^3131FF{1}^000000 minutes ^3131FF{2}^000000 seconds.

[Pat]
Welcome, welcome.
I am a helper of the Lv 50 arena stage.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
欢迎，欢迎。
我是50级竞技场关卡的助手。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
This ^3131FFLv 50 arena stage^000000
is accessable to characters from ^FF0000level 50^000000 to ^FF0000level 69^000000.

[Pat]
This level limitation is to prevent high level characters abusing low level arena stages. I hope you will understand.
Also we accept an entrance fee, 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
等级限制是为了防止高等级角色滥用低等级关卡，希望你能理解。
入场费为1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
Let me introduce you about the play rules of arena.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
让我介绍一下竞技场的规则。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
^3131FFWait in a chat room for your turn coming.^000000
When it's your turn, you will be automatically warped to an arena map.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
^3131FF请在聊天室排队等待。^000000
轮到你时，会自动将你传送到竞技场地图。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
As immediately as you enter, a timer to check your play time will be activated.
Please follow what ^3131FFHeel and Toe^000000 guides you.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
一进入竞技场，计时器就会启动，记录你的挑战用时。
请听从^3131FF希尔和托^000000的指引。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
You have a ^3131FF5 minutes^000000 battle time.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
你的战斗时间为^3131FF5分钟^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
After you clear every room including a boss room, you will be warped again to an ^3131FFending waiting room^000000.
You can only allow to stay in the waiting room for ^3131FF1 minute^000000, please hurry up to receive the arena points and leave.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
通过所有房间，包括首领房间后，会将你传送到^3131FF最终等待室^000000。
你只能在那里停留^3131FF1分钟^000000，请抓紧时间领取竞技场点数，然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
If you stay over 1 minute inside the ending waiting room, you will be forced outside and will not receive any arena points. Please remember that.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
请记住，在最终等待室停留超过1分钟，就会被强制送出，无法领取竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Pat]
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[帕特]
祝你玩得开心。

I am a helper of Lv 80 arena stage and my name is Epin.
I like reading and I am 19 years old...huh...? Don't you want to hear about me...?
scripts.translation:

我喜欢读书，今年19岁...咦...？你不想听我介绍自己...？

scripts.text:

Okay...

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Welcome to party arena stage.
I hope you will listen carefully to my introduction
since this party arena stage is a little bit different from player mode stages.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
欢迎来到队伍竞技场。
队伍关卡与单人模式略有不同，请仔细听我的介绍。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
^3131FFParty Arena Stage^000000
is accessible to players from ^FF0000level 10^000000 to ^FF0000level {0}^000000.

[Lunic]
Also, arena will be not be started until all of 5 party members enter the room. We accept an entrance fee 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
必须等5名队员全部进入房间，竞技场挑战才会开始。
入场费为1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Let me introduce you about the play rules of arena.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
让我介绍一下竞技场的规则。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
^3131FFGroup a party with your friends and wait in a chat room^000000.
You must form a party beforehand. If you didn't do, you could still play but you would have a lot of inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
^3131FF请和朋友组好队，再进入聊天室等待^000000。
一定要事先组队。
虽然没组队也能参加，但会很不方便。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Also please remember 5 players automatically warped to the arena room will be in order of ^FF0000entering a chat room^000000 not in order of ^FF0000party^000000. Please remember that.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
请记住，自动传送到竞技场的5名玩家是按^FF0000进入聊天室的顺序^000000选出的，而不是按^FF0000队伍^000000来分组。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
And please form a party with ^3131FF5 players^000000 before you enter a chat room.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
请在进入聊天室前，先组好一支^3131FF5人^000000队伍。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
When it becomes your turn, you will be warped into a small map where a warp and a help NPC are located.
In case you enter with members of a different party, use the warp to escape the map. Then you will return to the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
轮到你时，会将你传送到一张小地图，那里有传送门和助手NPC。
如果你和其他队伍的成员一起被传送进来，请使用传送门离开，返回等待室。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
In case you enter with your party members, please proceed speaking with the help NPC in the small map.
The help NPC is only accessible to talk ^FF0000 1 player ^000000at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
如果你和自己的队员一起进入，请与小地图中的助手NPC交谈，继续挑战。
助手NPC每次只能与^FF00001名玩家^000000交谈。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
The NPC will guide you and your party members to the actual arena room.
However, if anyone in the party ^3131FFdoes not have enough money to pay the entrance fee, he will be warped outside^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
助手NPC会将你和队员们送进竞技场。
不过，如果有人^3131FF付不起入场费，就会被传送出去^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Also be aware that you can only stay inside the map for ^FF0000 1 minute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
另外，请注意，你只能在这张地图停留^FF00001分钟^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
As immediately as you enter the arena map, a timer which calculates your battle time will be activated.
Please follow what ^3131FFSlipslowrun^000000 guides you.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
一进入竞技场，计时器就会启动，记录你的战斗用时。
请听从^3131FF斯利普斯洛伦^000000的指引。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
You will have ^3131FF10 minutes^000000 to clear the stage however it is not that easy to do. And you're advised to use the time wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
你们有^3131FF10分钟^000000的时间通关，不过挑战可不容易。
请合理利用时间。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
After you clear every room including a boss room, you will be warped again to an ^3131FFending waiting room^000000.
You can only allow to stay in the waiting room for ^3131FF1 minute^000000, please hurry up to receive the arena points and leave.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
通过所有房间，包括首领房间后，会将你传送到^3131FF最终等待室^000000。
你只能在那里停留^3131FF1分钟^000000，请抓紧时间领取竞技场点数，然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
If you stay over 1 minute inside the ending waiting room, you will be forced outside and will not receive any arena points. Please remember that.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
请记住，在最终等待室停留超过1分钟，就会被强制送出，无法领取竞技场点数。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Besides, if a party make a new record on time to clear the map,
^3131FFthe party master^000000 can record ^3131FFthe party name^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
另外，如果队伍刷新了通关时间纪录，^3131FF队长^000000就可以登记^3131FF队伍名称^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
In this case, if a party has more than one master or none, it is impossible to write ^FF0000the top party record^000000.
Therefore, it is strongly suggested to form one party before entering the arena map.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
如果参与挑战的人中有多个队长，或一个队长都没有，就无法登记^FF0000最佳队伍纪录^000000。
所以，强烈建议大家进入竞技场前先组好同一支队伍。

scripts.text:
[Lunic]
Thank you for listening and
I hope you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[卢尼克]
谢谢你听我介绍。
祝你玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Lonik]
